gwu_service_status_change_failure.reaction:
If the cause is "01" (flt failure at the switchover destination), check the status of the upf-service device at the switchover destination and restart the device manually (rst_gwu) if it is in flt status.
If the "cause" is "02" (system switchover destination is not yet installed), the upf-service at the switchover destination is manually installed into the system (ins_gwu).
If the "cause" is "03" (system switchover not completed), check the status of the upf-service equipment at the switchover d
gwu_service_status_change_failure.service_impact:
When both systems are in operation:
Call connection service can be continued.
In the upf-service single-system operation state

In the case of single-system operation state: Call connection service cannot be continued:
Call connection service cannot be continued
upf-service bisystem failure state
gwu_service_status_change_failure.message_fields:
lgwuXXX: Logical device number
cause=HH: Failure cause

bgp_peer_connection_fault.reaction: Checks for network errors between UPF and the peer device.
bgp_peer_connection_fault.service_impact:
User data communication affected
Terminal route advertisement to the peer BGP router stops, and the destination UPF route that the peer router should forward for downlink packets from the DN to the terminal is unknown. (The time until the route information is deleted on the peer router depends on the router's configuration.)

       (i:0-3)

ijk : device syntax
       (i:0-3)

kind=snd/rcv: kind=CCC

Signal name: sig=ccc...c
